english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for asking who someone is, in a direct or indirect question.
Use this as the default bare question for which person or which one.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for any person, especially in questions or free-choice statements.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an object question, including after a Cantonese preposition such as 同, 對, or 向.
Use this for an emphatic spoken question such as “Who ever thought of that?”

examples.english: Which person do you want to invite to dinner?

bin1 go3 soeng2 sik6 tong4 seoi2

examples.english: Whom do you want to have dinner with?
